claims.statement: Targeting a longer-term CAGR of around 15% for store expansion, with actual performance potentially a couple of percentage points higher or lower depending on real estate and permissions.
claims.quote: the internal number or internal ambition that we will look at will be that 15% number. And again, depending on how the situation turns on the real estate development, the permissions, etcetera, it could be a couple of percentage points higher or lower

claims.statement: Borrowings may go up to INR2,000 crores by the end of the year to manage capex.
claims.quote: So we might go to an INR2,000 crores borrowing by the end of the year, but that is all going towards managing capex.

facts.statement: Frontline store employees such as cashiers, packers, and shop assistants are non-permanent, while department managers and store managers are permanent.
facts.quote: So the frontline employees in the store, which are largely the cashiers and the packers and the shop assistants, are all non-permanent. The management employees, which are the department managers, store managers, and all that, are permanent.

facts.statement: The company maintains a project execution pipeline of land acquisition for the next two to three years of store openings.
facts.quote: as of now, we are sitting on a project execution pipeline of next two to three years of stores that we will open

facts.statement: Actual debt on the books was around INR900 crores as of 31st March, with around INR800 crores of commercial paper currently outstanding and INR1,000 crores of NCDs approved.
facts.quote: You said there's we have around INR900-odd crores of actual debt on our books as of 31st March. And if I look at commercial paper, etcetera, as of right now, it seems around INR800 crores are outstanding, plus we have INR1,000 crores of NCDs which you've approved.
